/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
      | .ok (some j) =>
        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")

/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
  let n := edge.size
  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
    if k = 0 then .ok false
    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | .t, .f => .ok true
      | _, _ => .ok false
  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)

/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none =>
        match vals[i]!.v with
        | .t => .ok (some i)
        | .f => .ok none
        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]

theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]

private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
  simp [sinceRiseAll]

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section HoldsFor

theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
      | none => R.u missing
      | some w =>
        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
  unfold holdsForAll
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
    the result false. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
    hn j h1 h2 h3
  simp [hc, this]

/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
  split at hf
  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf

end HoldsFor

end Temporal
end TrafficSpec

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
  | .var v =>
    match β.lookup v with
    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)

def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)

private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
  let s ← lit a
  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)

private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
  b (o.map (· == v)) name
private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boolean atoms by name, on one scene. Class atoms (`ru_*`, `st_*`, `dev_*` kinds) are dispatched
-- through the generated codecs, so the table cannot drift from ATOMS.md; attribute atoms are listed.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def evalAtomE (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason R := do
  match name, args with
  -- road users
  | "ru_subject", [x] => pure (b (ru_subject s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_aggregate", [_, .s w] => .error (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{w}")   -- resolved with the reading in `evalAll`
  | "ru_rider_posture", [x, f] =>
    match f with
    | .s "on_seat" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "standing_on_deck" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "holding_another_vehicle" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "stunt" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "posture field")
  | "ru_rider_posture_on_seat", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_stunt", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_emergency_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_emergency_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit EmergencyKind.ofString k) name)
  | "ru_official_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_official_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit OfficialKind.ofString k) name)
  -- control state
  | "kin_engine_running", [x] => pure (b (kin_engine_running s (← ent x)) name)
  | "kin_parking_brake", [x] => pure (b (kin_parking_brake s (← ent x)) name)
  -- structure attributes
  | "st_road_edge_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_road_edge_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_shoulder_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_shoulder_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_median_or_divider_opening", [r] => pure (b (st_median_or_divider_opening s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_crosswalk_marked", [r] => pure (b (st_crosswalk_marked s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_reserved_lane_class", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_reserved_lane_class s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ReservedClass.ofString k) name)
  | "st_turn_lane_side", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_turn_lane_side s (← ent r)) (← enumLit TurnSide.ofString k) name)
  | "st_parking_space_designation", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_parking_space_designation s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ParkingDesignation.ofString k) name)
  | "st_curb_zone_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbZoneKind.ofString k) name)
  | "st_curb_zone_colour", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_colour s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbColour.ofString k) name)

  -- class atoms through the generated codecs
  | n, [x] =>
    if n.startsWith "ru_" then
      match RoadUserClass.ofString (n.drop 3).toString with
      | some k => pure (b ((s.user (← ent x)).bind fun u =>
          if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)) n)
      | none => .error (unknownAtom n)
    else if n.startsWith "st_" then
      match StructureKind.ofString (n.drop 3).toString with
      | some k => pure (b (isKind s (← ent x) k) n)

    else .error (unknownAtom n)
  | n, _ =>
    if n.startsWith "ru_" && (RoadUserClass.ofString (n.drop 3).toString).isSome then .error (arity n)
    else if n.startsWith "st_" && (StructureKind.ofString (n.drop 3).toString).isSome then .error (arity n)
    else if n.startsWith "dev_" && (DeviceKind.ofString (n.drop 4).toString).isSome then .error (arity n)
    else if boolAtomNames.contains n then .error (arity n)

  boolAtomNames : List String := [

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
  match k with
  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")

def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
  match name, args with
  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_path_length", [x] => q (kin_path_length s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_gear", [x] => qz (kin_gear s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_throttle", [x] => q (kin_throttle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_service_brake", [x] => q (kin_service_brake s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_occupant_count", [x] => qn (ru_occupant_count s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", [x] => qn (ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
    | .s "count" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "adjacency field")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_adjacency_count", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_width", [r] => q (st_lane_width s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_curvature", [r] => q (st_curvature s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_grade", [r] => q (st_grade s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_distance", [r] => q (st_sight_distance s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_along_way", [x, w] => q (st_sight_along_way s (← ent x) (← ent w)) name
  | "st_parking_space_angle", [r] => q (st_parking_space_angle s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_region_geometry", [r, k] => comp (st_region_geometry_position s (← ent r)) k name
  | "st_region_geometry_distance", [x, r] => q (st_region_geometry_distance s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name
  | "dev_position", [d, k] => comp (dev_position s (← ent d)) k name
  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", [d] => q (dev_speed_limit_sign_value s (← ent d)) name
  | "env_visibility", [] => q (env_visibility s) name
  | "env_civil_time", [k] =>
    let ct := env_civil_time s
    match k with
    | .s "minute_of_day" => qn (ct.map (·.minuteOfDay)) name
    | .s "weekday" => qn (ct.map (·.weekday)) name
    | .s "month" => qn (ct.map (·.month)) name
    | .s "day" => qn (ct.map (·.day)) name
    | .s "year" => qn (ct.map (·.year)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "civil time field")

5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
7	  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
8	  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
9	  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
10	  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
11	  arguments with no default.
12	
13	  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
14	  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
15	  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
16	-/
17	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
18	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate
22	
23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	namespace Primitives
25	open Temporal
26	
27	/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
28	    numerator and denominator. -/
29	def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
30	  | [], [] => true
31	  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
32	    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
33	  | _, _ => false
34	
35	theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
36	  | [], [], _ => rfl
37	  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
38	    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
39	    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
40	    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
41	    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
42	    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
43	    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
44	    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
45	  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
46	  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
47	
48	/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
49	    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
50	structure SimpleEntry where
51	  id : RegionId
52	  boundary : List Vec
53	  flag : Thunk Bool
54	  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary
55	
56	/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
57	    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
58	def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
59	  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
60	      match st.boundary with
61	      | none => acc
62	      | some b =>
63	        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
64	        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []
65	
66	/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
67	    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
68	    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
69	structure Ctx where
70	  scenes : Array Scene
71	  times : Array Q
72	  ρ : Reading
73	  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
74	  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
75	  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
76	  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
77	      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
78	  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes
79	
80	/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
81	    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
82	def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
83	  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
84	  | some e => e.flag.get
85	  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly
86	
87	/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
88	    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
89	theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
90	  unfold simpleIn
91	  split
92	  · rename_i e h
93	    have hp := List.find?_some h
94	    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
95	    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
96	  · rfl
97	
98	def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
99	  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }

102	/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
103	    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
104	inductive DArg
105	  | v (id : Nat)
106	  | s (lit : String)
107	  | n (nat : Nat)
108	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

/-
  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
  arguments with no default.

  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Primitives
open Temporal

/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
    numerator and denominator. -/
def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
  | _, _ => false

theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
structure SimpleEntry where
  id : RegionId
  boundary : List Vec
  flag : Thunk Bool
  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary

/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | none => acc
      | some b =>
        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []

/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
structure Ctx where
  scenes : Array Scene
  times : Array Q
  ρ : Reading
  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes

/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
  | some e => e.flag.get
  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
  unfold simpleIn
  split
  · rename_i e h
    have hp := List.find?_some h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
  · rfl

def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size

/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
inductive DArg
  | v (id : Nat)
  | s (lit : String)
  | n (nat : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an

170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/

173	  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
174	    | some r => pure r
175	    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
176	  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
177	    | .ok S => pure S
178	    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
179	  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
180	    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
181	      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
182	  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩

185	    match sc.window with
186	    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
187	    | none => true

205	    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
206	      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
207	    else pure got
208	  | _ => pure got
209	end Scenario

211	end TrafficSpec

  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that

  drop them once a value is decided.

import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason

  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩

def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl

def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
  match o with
  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
  prefT : Array Nat
  prefU : Array Nat
  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)

def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size

    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩

private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
    omega

private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
  simp only [cnt, build]
  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]

/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
      rw [hf.1]; omega
    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
    omega
  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
    omega
  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
end RangeAgg

end TrafficSpec

match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some q => .ok q | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Scene-level helpers over atoms
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
  let n := c.n
  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
      | none => prev)) #[]
  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => .error .outOfRange
    | some win =>
      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
      else
        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The primitives
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute

private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)

private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
  let vv := Geom.dot v v
  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
  else
    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
    | .error r => .error (match r with
        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
        | other => other)
    | .ok Δ => .ok Δ

/-- The centres approach each other within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_within (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array R :=
  each c fun s => match closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | .error w => R.u w
    | .ok o => R.ofBool o.isSome

/-- The time of closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_time (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (t, _) => pure t
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_time")

/-- The centre distance at closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_distance (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (_, dist) => pure dist
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_distance")

/-- The legend conditions of device d hold now for road user x: a time window on a listed day (or a
    calendar class the scene declares), any occupancy or class condition, children present. -/
def prim_conditions_hold (c : Ctx) (d : DeviceId) (x : TrackId) : Array R :=
  each c fun s =>
    let conds := match dev_zone_sign_conditions s d with
      | some cd => some cd
      | none => dev_regulatory_sign_conditions s d
    R.bindOpt conds (.absentAtom "dev_zone_sign_conditions") fun cd =>
      let timeOk : R :=
        if cd.windows.isEmpty then R.t
        else R.bindOpt (env_civil_time s) (.absentAtom "env_civil_time") fun ct =>
          R.any (cd.windows.map fun w =>
            let dayOk : R := match w.calendarClass with
              | some cls => R.ofOption (s.assumption cls) (.assumptionMissing cls)
              | none => R.ofBool (w.weekdays.isEmpty || w.weekdays.contains ct.weekday)
            R.and dayOk (R.ofBool (inWindow w ct.minuteOfDay)))
      let occOk : R := match cd.minOccupancy with
        | none => R.t
        | some n => bAtom ((ru_occupant_count s x).map (· ≥ n)) "ru_occupant_count"
      let clsOk : R := match cd.vehicleClass with
        | none => R.t
        | some k => bAtom (hasClassOpt s x k) "ru_class"
      let childOk : R :=
        if cd.whenChildrenPresent then R.any (s.tracks.map fun y => bAtom (ru_child s y) "ru_child") else R.t
      R.and (R.and timeOk occOk) (R.and clsOk childOk)

/-- The signed lateral offset of region r from road user x (m, left positive): the component,
    perpendicular to x's heading, of the vector from x's reference point to the nearest point of
    r's boundary; zero where the reference point lies inside r. Where several boundary points are
    equally nearest, their common component; undefined where those components differ. -/
def prim_region_lateral_offset (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some h := kin_heading s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly then pure Q.zero
    else
      let lats ← (Geom.nearestPoints p poly).mapM fun q =>
        match Geom.inFrame h (Geom.vsub q p) with
        | some (_, lat) => pure lat
        | none => throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
      match lats with
      | [] => throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
      | l :: ls => if ls.all (Q.eq · l) then pure l else throw (.undefined "prim_region_lateral_offset")

/-- The signed distance (m) from road user x's reference point to region r, along carrier l's
    designated direction, on the line through the reference point parallel to that direction. r is
    a closed set: a vertex the line only touches and an edge it runs along are points of r it meets.
    Zero where the reference point lies in r or on its boundary; where every point of r on the line
    lies ahead, the distance to the nearest of them; where every one lies behind, minus the distance

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/-- The subject moves: its speed above the halt tolerance. -/
def subjectMoving : Formula := .cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance

/-- The two bodies' projections on the subject's heading share no length. -/
def noOverlap : Formula := .cmp (.measure "rel_longitudinal_overlap" [vSubject, vB]) .lt zeroMetres

def aheadAligned : Formula :=
  .and subjectMoving
    (.and (.atom "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vB, .lit "ahead"] [])
      (.and noOverlap (.atom "rel_same_direction" [vSubject, vB] [pOvertakeSameDirectionCos])))

/-- b behind the subject, the projections sharing no length. -/
def behindClear : Formula := .and (.atom "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vB, .lit "behind"] []) noOverlap

/-- The moving subject drawing past b: b neither ahead-aligned nor behind. -/
def alongside : Formula := .and (.not aheadAligned) (.and (.not behindClear) subjectMoving)

    alongside at every observation since, up to and including the one at which b comes to be
    behind (the recognition). -/

  .and (.not aheadAligned) (.since (.or alongside (.rises behindClear)) aheadAligned)

  .not (.holdsFor .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.not (.and underWay φ)))

    (7 m/s; 0 in branch_1, which slows the subject to 3 m/s). Its lead over the subject is
    36 − 3k m: ahead-aligned (gap ≥ 2 m) up to k = 10, alongside at k = 11, 12, 13 (lead 3, 0,
    −3 m), behind and clear at k = 14 (lead −6 m), the recognition.

    where every 10 s window behind is covered. The pass is under way at k = 11…14 (U); "the first
    observations of the pass" are k ≤ 12, "the later ones" k ≥ 13, "before the pass" k ≤ 9.
  - Zone sign legend: 07:00–08:00 any day; the civil time is 07:30 (conditions hold) or 10:00
    (they do not). Beacon 200 governs lane 10.
  - Reading values: halt tolerance 0.1 m/s (speeds 3, 7, 10 m/s, or 0), same-direction cosine
    0.9 (headings identical), overtake window 10 s (the pass from k = 10 to k = 14 takes 4 s).

import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

def ext : Q × Q × Q := (m 2, m 1, m 1)

  { year := 2026, month := 11, day := 16, weekday := 0, minuteOfDay := minute }

/-- 07:30, inside the legend's window; 10:00, outside it. -/
def held : Nat := 450
def off : Nat := 600

def schoolHours : Conditions := { windows := [{ startMinute := 420, endMinute := 480 }] }

def laneRect (id : RegionId) (x0 x1 y0 y1 : Int) : Structure :=
  Build.lane id [(m x0, m y0), (m x1, m y0), (m x1, m y1), (m x0, m y1)] Build.east

def roads (zoneEnd : Int) : List Structure :=
  [laneRect 10 (-50) zoneEnd (-2) 2, laneRect 11 (-50) 300 2 6] ++
  (if zoneEnd < 300 then [laneRect 12 zoneEnd 300 (-2) 2] else [])

def subjectAt (vs : Int) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  if k = 0 then Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (m 0, m 0) Build.east Q.zero ext
  else Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (m (vs * ((k : Int) - 1)), m 0) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond vs) ext

def otherAt (vs : Int) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (m (vs * ((k : Int) - 1) + 36 - 3 * (k : Int)), m 4) Build.east
    (Units.metresPerSecond (vs - 3)) ext

def pedestrian : RoadUser :=
  Build.user 3 [.pedestrian] (m 20, m (-5)) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 1) (cm 30, cm 30, m 1)

def beacon (inoperative flashing : Bool) : Device :=
  { Build.device 200 .speedLimitBeacon [10] with inoperative := some inoperative, flashing := some flashing }

structure Cfg where
  vs : Int := 10
  other : Bool := true
  extra : List RoadUser := []
  zoneEnd : Int := 300
  zoneKind : ZoneKind := .schoolCrossing
  beacons : List Device := []
  minute : Nat := held
  inSession : Bool := true
  margin : Bool := false
  pupils : Bool := false

    ([subjectAt c.vs k] ++ (if c.other then [otherAt c.vs k] else []) ++ c.extra)
    (roads c.zoneEnd)
    ([Build.zoneSign 100 [10] c.zoneKind false (some schoolHours)] ++ c.beacons)
    (env := { civilTime := some (civil c.minute) })
    (assumptions := [("asm.school_in_session_day", c.inSession),

                     ("asm.pupils_in_class", c.pupils)])

  Build.trace 15 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t => sceneOf (f k) k t

    k = 14; the recording begins 14 s before the recognition. -/

/-- `branch_3` (not_applicable): an operational beacon governs lane 10, not flashing, pupils in class. -/

  passTrace fun k => { beacons := [beacon (decide (k ≥ 13)) false], pupils := true }

/-- `occasion_s7_outside` (not_applicable): the beacon inoperative at k ≤ 9, operational and not
    flashing from k = 10; pupils in class. -/
def occasion_s7_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { beacons := [beacon (decide (k ≤ 9)) false], pupils := true }

/-- `occasion_s9` (violated): the operational beacon not flashing at k ≤ 12, flashing from k = 13;
    pupils in class. -/
def occasion_s9Trace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { beacons := [beacon false (decide (k ≥ 13))], pupils := true }

/-- `occasion_s9_outside` (not_applicable): the operational beacon flashing at k ≤ 9, not flashing
    from k = 10; pupils in class. -/
def occasion_s9_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { beacons := [beacon false (decide (k ≤ 9))], pupils := true }

/-- `occasion_s10` (violated): the beacon inoperative at k ≤ 12, operational and flashing from
    k = 13; 10:00, the zone sign's conditions false throughout. -/
def occasion_s10Trace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { beacons := [beacon (decide (k ≤ 12)) true], pupils := true, minute := off }

/-- `occasion_s10_outside` (not_applicable): the beacon operational (flashing) at k ≤ 9,
    inoperative from k = 10; the zone sign's conditions false throughout. -/
def occasion_s10_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { beacons := [beacon (decide (k ≥ 10)) true], pupils := true, minute := off }

/-- `occasion_s11` (violated): no beacon; 10:00 (conditions false) at k ≤ 12, 07:30 (true) from k = 13. -/
def occasion_s11Trace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { minute := if k ≤ 12 then off else held }

/-- `occasion_s11_outside` (not_applicable): no beacon; 07:30 (conditions true) at k ≤ 9, 10:00
    (false) from k = 10. -/
def occasion_s11_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  passTrace fun k => { minute := if k ≤ 9 then held else off }

    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_363_4"

  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .compliant
  , witness "occasion_s3" occasion_s3Trace .violated
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occasion_s3_outsideTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s7" occasion_s7Trace .violated
  , witness "occasion_s7_outside" occasion_s7_outsideTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s9" occasion_s9Trace .violated
  , witness "occasion_s9_outside" occasion_s9_outsideTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s10" occasion_s10Trace .violated
  , witness "occasion_s10_outside" occasion_s10_outsideTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_s11" occasion_s11Trace .violated

/-

  THE READING (the blueprint's; the coding session records here, per span, how each element,
  operationalization and composition below is written, and every choice the text did not dictate).

  Spans:
    s1 (subject): The driver of a vehicle
    s2 (obligation): shall not overtake and pass another vehicle traveling in the same direction
    s3 (trigger): in an area designated as a school zone or school crossing zone
    s4 (boilerplate): except:
    s5 (exception): (a) On a day on which the school is not in session;
    s6 (exception): (b) During the period from a half hour after school is no longer in operation to a half hour before school is next in operation;
    s7 (exception): (c) If the zone is designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
    s8 (exception): during the hours when the pupils of the school are in class
    s9 (exception): and the yellow lights of the speed limit beacon are not flashing in the manner which indicates that the speed limit is in effect;
    s10 (exception): or (d) If the zone is not designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
    s11 (exception): during the times when the sign designating the school zone or school crossing zone indicates that the speed limit is not in effect.
    s12 (definitional): As used in this section, “speed limit beacon” means a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately to indicate when the speed limit in a school zone or school crossing zone is in effect.

  Elements (span → atoms, derived):
    s1: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle'], derived []
    s2: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle', 'kin.speed'], derived ['drv.interaction.overtake_pass']
    s3: atoms ['dev.zone_sign', 'dev.governs', 'rel.occupies', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    s7: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon', 'dev.governs', 'dev.inoperative', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    s9: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon'], derived []
    s10: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon', 'dev.governs', 'dev.inoperative', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    s11: atoms ['dev.zone_sign', 'prim.conditions_hold'], derived []
    s12: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon'], derived []

  No magnitude below is this file's own: parameters name the reading, literals are the text's.

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_363_4

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vSubject : Arg := .var "subject"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pHaltSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.halt_speed_tolerance"
def pOvertakeSameDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.overtake_same_direction_cos"
def pOvertakeWindow : Term := .param "p.overtake_window"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- Quantifier variables: `b` the other vehicle, `r` the travel region, `z` the zone sign. -/
def vB : Arg := .var "b"
def vR : Arg := .var "r"
def vZ : Arg := .var "z"

/-- s1, s2: membership of the admitted aggregate `vehicle` (DEF-NRS-484A-320). -/
def isVehicle (x : Arg) : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [x, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := isVehicle vSubject

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The occasion: the pass of `b` under way (record `occasion.under_way`).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/-- The subject moves: its speed above the halt tolerance. -/
def subjectMoving : Formula := .cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [vSubject]) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance

/-- The two bodies' projections on the subject's heading share no length. -/
def noOverlap : Formula := .cmp (.measure "rel_longitudinal_overlap" [vSubject, vB]) .lt zeroMetres

/-- b ahead of the moving subject with headings aligned (the observation that begins the pass). -/
def aheadAligned : Formula :=
  .and subjectMoving
    (.and (.atom "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vB, .lit "ahead"] [])
      (.and noOverlap (.atom "rel_same_direction" [vSubject, vB] [pOvertakeSameDirectionCos])))

/-- b behind the subject, the projections sharing no length. -/
def behindClear : Formula := .and (.atom "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vB, .lit "behind"] []) noOverlap

/-- The moving subject drawing past b: b neither ahead-aligned nor behind. -/
def alongside : Formula := .and (.not aheadAligned) (.and (.not behindClear) subjectMoving)

/-- U: an observation after the last one at which b was ahead-aligned, the subject moving and b
    alongside at every observation since, up to and including the one at which b comes to be
    behind (the recognition). -/
def underWay : Formula :=
  .and (.not aheadAligned) (.since (.or alongside (.rises behindClear)) aheadAligned)

/-- A span read `some_moment` over the pass. -/
def someMoment (φ : Formula) : Formula :=
  .not (.holdsFor .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.not (.and underWay φ)))

/-- A span read `throughout` the pass. -/
def throughout (φ : Formula) : Formula :=
  .holdsFor .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.implies underWay φ)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The elements.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/-- s2: b travelling: its speed above the halt tolerance at some observation of the pass. -/
def otherTravelling : Formula :=
  someMoment (.cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [vB]) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance)

/-- s3: a zone sign of kind school or school_crossing, not an end sign. -/
def schoolZoneSign (z : Arg) : Formula :=
  .and (.or (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [z, .lit "school"] [])
            (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [z, .lit "school_crossing"] []))
       (.not (.atom "dev_zone_sign_end" [z] []))

/-- s3: the subject's footprint overlaps r, which z governs (some observation of the pass). -/
def inZone : Formula :=
  someMoment (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, vR] [])
                   (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [vZ, vR] []) (schoolZoneSign vZ)))

/-- s7, s10: a speed limit beacon governing r that is not inoperative. -/
def operationalBeacon (v : String) : Formula :=
  .existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_beacon") v
    (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [.var v, vR] []) (.not (.atom "dev_inoperative" [.var v] [])))

/-- (a) s5: not a school day. -/
def excA : Formula := throughout (.not (.asm "asm.school_in_session_day"))

/-- (b) s6: outside the operation margin. -/
def excB : Formula := throughout (.asm "asm.school_outside_operation_margin")

/-- (c) s7, s8, s9: an operational beacon governs r, pupils in class, and no operational beacon
    governing r flashes. -/
def excC : Formula :=
  throughout
    (.and (operationalBeacon "bc")
      (.and (.asm "asm.pupils_in_class")
        (.forallDevice (.lit "speed_limit_beacon") "bf"
          (.implies (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [.var "bf", vR] [])
                          (.not (.atom "dev_inoperative" [.var "bf"] [])))
                    (.not (.atom "dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing" [.var "bf"] []))))))

/-- (d) s10, s11: no operational beacon governs r, and the zone sign's conditions do not hold. -/
def excD : Formula :=
  throughout
    (.and (.not (operationalBeacon "bd"))
          (.not (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [vZ, vSubject] [])))

    throughout it. -/
def passInZone : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "r"
    (.existsDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "z"
      (.and inZone
        (.and (.not excA) (.and (.not excB) (.and (.not excC) (.not excD))))))
